description: Header file defining structures, enums, and function prototypes for unpacking trees in a version control system, including error handling, options configuration, and merge operations.

methods.name: setup_unpack_trees_porcelain
methods.description: Sets up user-friendly error messages for unpacking trees commands.

methods.name: clear_unpack_trees_porcelain
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for unpacking trees error messages.

methods.name: unpack_trees
methods.description: Performs unpacking of trees with specified options.

methods.name: update_sparsity
methods.description: Updates sparsity settings during unpacking, returning status.

methods.name: verify_uptodate
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry is up-to-date.

methods.name: threeway_merge
methods.description: Performs a three-way merge of cache entries.

methods.name: twoway_merge
methods.description: Performs a two-way merge of cache entries.

methods.name: bind_merge
methods.description: Performs a bind merge of cache entries.

methods.name: oneway_merge
methods.description: Performs a one-way merge of cache entries.

methods.name: stash_worktree_untracked_merge
methods.description: Merges untracked worktree files into the index.
